name: site-monetique-tunisie
description: Site institutionnel Monétique Tunisie — CMS Drupal (découplé) + site Next.js statique

scripts.drupal:install: cd drupal && . scripts/php-env.sh && composer install --no-interaction && vendor/bin/drush site:install standard --db-url=sqlite://localhost/sites/default/files/.ht.sqlite --site-name='Monétique Tunisie' --account-name=admin --locale=fr -y && vendor/bin/drush en smt_site -y && vendor/bin/drush pm:uninstall automated_cron announcements_feed help views_ui menu_ui menu_link_content block_content taxonomy -y && vendor/bin/drush php:script web/modules/custom/smt_site/scripts/import.php
scripts.drupal:update: cd drupal && . scripts/php-env.sh && composer install --no-interaction && vendor/bin/drush updatedb -y && vendor/bin/drush cr
scripts.dev: concurrently -n cms,site -c blue,green "npm run dev:cms" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.dev:strapi: concurrently -n strapi,site -c blue,green "npm --prefix cms run develop" "CMS_BACKEND=strapi npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.audit: npm --prefix web audit --omit=dev && (cd drupal && . scripts/php-env.sh && composer audit)
